title: A Metric Mix-Up Left A Plane 24,600 Pounds Short
hook: A metric mistake left a plane 24,600 pounds short.
closing: Unit errors can destroy machines or endanger passengers, so conversion checks are safety systems.
question: Should every country use metric?

segments.say: Only 5% of people live where metric is not official, creating dangerous friction when systems meet.
A mixed-unit calculation dropped NASA's orbiter to 57 kilometers, costing the entire spacecraft.
The plane received 20,400 pounds of fuel, forcing a mid-flight glide after its tanks ran dry.
